hooks.command: cmake -B build -DKOTONE_BUILD_OBS_PLUGIN=OFF -DKOTONE_BUILD_TESTS=ON 1>&2 && cmake --build build --config Release 1>&2 && ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure 1>&2 && (if [ -d profiler/tests ]; then python3 -m pytest profiler/tests 1>&2 || pytest profiler/tests 1>&2; fi) || exit 2
